name: research-engineering-router
description: Provider-configurable evidence triage and verified software/research workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence triage with your configured decision model
interface.longDescription: Provider-configurable evidence screening for code audits and research, with primary-model ownership and verification. A limited six-pair evaluation measured 10.20% fewer primary-model tokens and 20.42% longer whole-process time. No general savings guarantee. Python 3.10+ and private provider setup required.
defaultPrompt: Use Research & Engineering Router to select relevant evidence and verify a scoped implementation or research task.
